entities.name: Pablo Gómez Álvarez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pablo Gómez Álvarez is a Mexican politician. He was the president of the Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD) and has served in both houses of Congress. On 8 November 2021 he was appointed to head the Unidad de Inteligencia Financiera, the country's financial intelligence unit.
